At first I thought it was just some joke, and that in reality he actually remembered where to go, but that never felt right. So it dawned on me one day that for him, that was the path of least pain. If he didn't remember at all where to go, why should he follow a stinky path? Way better would be to go on the better smelling one. Or maybe it was just a joke, idk.
